instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand in front of your thighs.
2. Keep your back flat and shoulders back.
3. Bend at your hips and knees to lower the kettlebell toward the floor.
4. Push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to stand up.
5. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control. Switch hands. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you lift and inhale as you lower.
2. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
3. Hinge at the hips, do not round your lower back.
4. Brace your core to resist twisting toward the loaded side.

instructions:
1. Sit in the leg press machine and extend one leg, placing the forefoot on the lower edge of the platform with the heel hanging off.
2. Keep a slight bend in the knee.
3. Press through the forefoot to push the platform up by extending your ankle.
4. Squeeze your calf at the top.
5. Lower the heel below the platform edge for a full stretch under control. Switch legs. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a slight bend in the knee throughout.
2. Let the heel drop fully at the bottom for a deep stretch.
3. Pause briefly at the top contraction.
4. Move at a steady pace to keep tension on the calf.

instructions:
1. Sit in the 45 degree leg press and place one foot flat on the platform, mid-foot centered.
2. Keep your back against the seat and release the safety handles.
3. Press through your foot to extend the leg and push the platform up.
4. Stop just short of locking the knee.
5. Lower the platform under control until your knee nears your chest. Switch legs. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
2. Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
3. Press through the whole foot, not just the toes.
4. Keep your hips and lower back flat against the seat.

instructions:
1. Stand on your right leg holding a dumbbell in your right hand, knee slightly bent.
2. Hinge at the hip and extend your left leg straight back.
3. Lower the dumbbell toward the floor until your torso and back leg are parallel to the ground.
4. Keep your back flat and hips level.
5. Drive through your standing heel to return to standing. Switch sides. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.
2. Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
3. Keep your hips square to the floor, do not let them open.
4. Practice without weight first to learn balance.

instructions:
1. Anchor a resistance band low and hold the free end in your right hand.
2. Stand on your left leg with the knee slightly bent.
3. Hinge at the hip and extend your right leg straight back.
4. Lower your torso until it is parallel to the floor against the band tension.
5. Drive your hips forward to return to standing. Switch sides. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you hinge forward, inhale as you return.
2. Keep a slight bend in the standing knee for balance.
3. Keep your back flat and shoulders down.
4. Keep your hips level, do not let the pelvis rotate.
